## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `domain:spec` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). The composition route ruling A names: a host can leave out `plugin-auth`'s organization page

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T12:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1:** it is on a p1 chain. objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 (the v18 move, ruled A′) lands only after this fix, and #2709 is the wall for cloud's p1 cards. Cloud's console cannot boot under ruling A without it.
- **Not a new decision:** ruling A on #23015 (`6134056653`) keeps one default record page "by overlay-by-name or by composition". The cloud seat measured that overlay-by-name does not reach this case, so composition is the named route.
- **Lane:** a host-composition switch on `plugin-auth` widens its published options, so `Clause-②: yes` and spec-lane work, with the `plugin-auth` file declared in the claim.
- **Direction:**
  - `AuthPlugin` gains a declared option by which a host says it ships its own `sys_organization` default record page. With the option set, `plugin-auth` does not register `sys_organization_detail`.
  - The **default is unchanged**: every deployment that does not set it keeps `plugin-auth`'s page.
  - ⛔ No precedence ladder and ⛔ no registration-order rule (ruling A).
  - **Pins:**
    - with the option, a host's own default is the single default and the boot succeeds;
    - without it, `plugin-auth`'s page registers as today;
    - with both pages present and no option, `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT` still refuses.
- Cloud's half (setting the option, retiring its order-pinning test) is objectstack-ai/cloud#2773's.

File surface (at `origin/main` `6c181625f` or later; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`:
  - one declared option on `AuthPluginOptions` (`:151`) by which a host says it ships its own `sys_organization` default record page;
  - the conditional on the page list at `:674`. With the option set, `SysOrganizationDetailPage` is not registered. `SysUserDetailPage` is unchanged.
  - A cross-lane touch, declared here as triage directs.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/manifest.ts`, only if it declares the same page list.
- The option's tests in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/`, with the three pins triage names:
  - with the option, a host's own default is the single default and the boot succeeds;
  - without it, `plugin-auth`'s page registers as today;
  - with both pages present and no option, `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT` still refuses.
- The page that documents `AuthPlugin`'s options (README or `content/docs/**`).
- One `.changeset/23254-*.md`.
- ⛔ No precedence ladder and ⛔ no registration-order rule (ruling A). ⛔ The default is unchanged. ⛔ No change to the one-default refusal itself (PR #23206). ⛔ Cloud's half (setting the option, retiring its order-pinning test) is objectstack-ai/cloud#2773's, not this card's.
Container & model: `S` (one option, one conditional, three pins, docs), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier`. It widens `plugin-auth`'s published options, so it owes a review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before the queue, by an isolated at-tier subagent.
Clause-②: yes (a new declared `AuthPluginOptions` key; the default is unchanged)
Responsibility: the option is `plugin-auth`'s, routed to the spec lane by triage under 强制条款② | no host can compose without the page today: overlay-by-name is refused at registration (measured by the cloud seat) | reached by any host that ships its own `sys_organization` default record page, the cloud control plane first (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 waits on it)
Thread-read: 6146018242
Serial constraints cleared (the file lists of all 6 open PRs and all open `pm:dispatched` claims, read in this act):
- No open PR or in-flight claim touches `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/**`.

## ✅ ACCEPT (seat review): PR #23309 at `3f7b18399`. The contract-tier review is owed before the queue · `domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883) · `session_012uFegdfR6K6uqvLzt7XsdZ` · 2026-10-13T17:24Z

**PR shape.** Draft against `main`. Line 1 is `Fixes #23254`; line 2 is the claim's `Clause-②:` line, verbatim. 4 files, +306 / −1. It touches no governed path and sits far under the human-merge threshold. `main` (`543b33dee`) was merged in with a merge commit.

**The change, read in the diff.**
- **The option.** `AuthPluginOptions.registerOrganizationRecordPage?: boolean`, `@default true`.
  - It is read as `!== false`, so only an explicit `false` leaves out `SysOrganizationDetailPage`, and an explicit `undefined` keeps the page.
  - `SysUserDetailPage` registers either way.
  - Its docblock names what `false` removes and what stays, and what a host without its own page then sees: the synthesized default layout, without the Members / Invitations / Teams tabs.
- **Within ruling A** (`6134056653`): the option uses composition only. It adds no precedence ladder and no registration-order rule, and PR #23206's one-default refusal is untouched.
- **The `info` line.** With `false`, `init()` logs one `info` line naming the option. That is the loud-absence rule; it is not pinned, because it is prose.

**Triage's three pins** (`6146018242`), each with a control, in a real `ObjectKernel` with `ObjectQLPlugin`, run in both plugin orders:
1. With `false`, the host's page is the only `sys_organization` default and the boot succeeds. Its control is pin 3.
2. With no option, `plugin-auth`'s page is the default. Its control: `false` with no host page gives zero defaults.
3. With both pages and no option, the boot is refused with `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT` (422), naming both holders. Its control: an explicit `true` is refused the same way.

**The ablation.** Unconditional registration turns pins 1 and 2 red. The file was restored to blob == HEAD.

**The changeset and docs.**
- The changeset is `'@objectstack/plugin-auth': minor`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, and states the adoption in one line.
- The option is documented in the package README's Configuration section, which ships in the tarball. That is the page that lists `AuthPlugin`'s options.

**H2, nothing dangles.** No nav item or app names the page: record pages resolve by object plus `isDefault`. The `pages.sys_organization_detail.label` translations are read only when the page is registered.

**Measurements.**
- **On the merged head:**
  - `plugin-auth`: 138 files and 2794 tests passed (10 skipped); typecheck passed, with the ledger unchanged.
  - 68 derived gates, each exit 0.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: 108 entry points load, after a full build.
- **Before the merge:** `spec` `test:repo`, 58 files and 1007 tests passed. It was not re-run after the merge, because the diff touches nothing under `packages/spec`, and CI runs it.

**The out-of-scope note.** `DefaultRecordPageConflictError`'s remedy text names the generic remedy ("compose the deployment without the package that ships the other"). It was left unchanged on purpose, and it stays in the PR's Acceptance notes.

**Landing to-do, recorded now:**
1. `needs:contract-review` goes on the PR in this act. The review runs on `3f7b18399`: `Clause-②: yes`, an added published option.
2. When the review is PASS and every check is green: ready, then auto-merge, then the queue, confirmed by `added_to_merge_queue`.
3. When it merges: a landing record here, and `pm:dispatched` comes off. Cloud then sets the option under objectstack-ai/cloud#2773.

## Landed: PR #23309 → `404fc477e` (`Fixes #23254`). `registerOrganizationRecordPage: false` lets a host that ships its own `sys_organization` default record page be the single default

`domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `os-support-ai` · session `session_012uFegdfR6K6uqvLzt7XsdZ` · 2026-10-13T18:10Z · holder of claim `6147450905`.

- **Path:**
  - ACCEPT `6151254191`.
  - The contract-tier review PASSed on `3f7b18399` (`6151463116`).
  - Every check was green or an expected skip (11 of 11 in the roster), with `mergeable: clean`. `check-governed-merges` reported it NOT governed, at 307 lines.
  - Ready and auto-merge went on at 2026-10-13T17:43Z through the relay. The PR entered the merge queue at 2026-10-13T17:47Z, and the queue merged it at 2026-10-13T18:09Z.
- **On `main` at `404fc477e`:** the squash is the PR's 4 files, +306 / −1. Each blob equals the reviewed head's, and the `patch-id --stable` equals that of `543b33dee..3f7b18399`: byte-identical to the reviewed head.
- **Closing keywords:** this card closed as `completed`, and the PR names no other issue. `pm:dispatched` comes off in this act.
- **Unblocked:** objectstack-ai/cloud#2773. Cloud sets `registerOrganizationRecordPage: false` beside its own `cloud_organization_detail` and retires its order-pinning test, then takes the pin bump that objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 waits on.
- **Carried:** #23310, filed from review flags 2 and 3. It covers two gaps:
  - `os serve` and `plugin-dev`'s `DevPlugin` do not forward the option, so an app under `os serve` that ships its own `sys_organization` default page is still refused;
  - `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT`'s remedy clause names a step this holder cannot take.

  Neither touches cloud's p1 chain.
